2610.08358.title: Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration
2610.08358.paper_summary: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.
2610.08358.paper_summary_zh: 後訓練量化是將視覺Transformer（ViTs）適應於邊緣計算和記憶體預算的標準途徑，但量化模型在分佈變化下變得特別脆弱。測試時適應（TTA）在沒有標籤的情況下解決這些變化，但大多數現有方法與量化推理的限制不太一致。現行的TTA方法通過反向傳播來恢復準確性，而無需反向傳播的方法通常仍然會因額外的前向傳遞或參數更新而產生開銷，輕量級的特徵或邏輯層級方法僅恢復部分損失。在這些方法中，一種特定於量化的失效模式未被直接針對：在變化下，激活值以不同的方式佔據冷凍量化器的校準範圍，扭曲了其代碼分佈。我們提出了量化器對齊再校準（QuAR），這是一種針對量化ViTs的單次通過TTA方法，既不進行反向傳播，也不更新任何模型參數。QuAR在冷凍量化器的輸入處重新校準激活值，將測試流的每通道運行統計數據映射回源校準。在ImageNet-C上使用ViT-B時，QuAR在3位、4位、6位和8位權重/激活精度下，達到了最先進的無反向傳播TTA方法中最高的平均準確率，在8位時超越最強基準2.28點，在3位時超越4.00點，延遲降低46%，記憶體開銷僅為0.17 MB（峰值推理記憶體的0.01%）。分析和診斷將增益追溯到這些量化器的每通道不匹配減少，這恢復了基準未改變或進一步扭曲的代碼分佈。在持續流、非獨立同分佈標籤變化、七個分佈外套件和三個其他骨幹中，單一固定配置仍然領先。
